Peters VA Medical Center (Bronx, NY) Background: The Library Network Office (LNO) has communicated reductions to national journal packages that impact access to Lippincott Williams & Wilkins (LWW) nursing titles. To maintain facility-level access to core nursing evidence and mitigate interlibrary loan workload and clinical impact, the Bronx VA Medical Center seeks a site subscription to the Ovid Nursing Full Text Plus collection. This subscription will provide uninterrupted full-text access to premier nursing journals required for Evidence-Based Practice (EBP), quality improvement (QI), nursing education, and research. Scope of Work The Contractor shall provide site-wide, IP-authenticated online access to the Ovid Nursing Full Text Plus journal collection for the Bronx VA Medical Center, including the main campus and all affiliated Community Based Outpatient Clinics (CBOCs) and Vet Center. Access must permit an unlimited number of simultaneous users and include coverage back to 2015 for journals included in the package, as provided by Ovid/Wolters Kluwer. Access must be available via the VA LibLynx gateway and Ovid platform. Objectives This acquisition aims to: Ensure continuous access to authoritative nursing full-text journals for clinicians, educators, and trainees.
